items.title: Holman Bill — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: The Invention for Guitar and Trumpet was one of the few assignments that Stan gave me at the time. He knew I was interested in lines and counterpoint and things like that. So he took the name of a contrapuntal form, which is the invention. He had Maynard to play high and Sal to play fast, and asked me to write the piece for them. I did. I don‟t like it at all. That‟s probably the worst chart I wrote for Kenton, and it‟s been recorded the most and re-released on this label and that label. It‟s coming back to haunt…
So, there it is. I‟m responsible.
